urlText: L1 Dulwich Hill, L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines weeknight closures due to maintenance
content:
From Monday 14 to Wednesday 16 April, nightly from 8pm to 1am, L1 Dulwich Hill, L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines light rail services will be impacted by closures due to planned trackwork and maintenance works.

During this time:
  • L1 Dulwich Hill line light rail services will not run.
  • Use alternative transport including L1 replacement bus services, regular bus services or walking if able to between Central Grand Concourse and Dulwich Hill.
  • L2 and L3 light rail services will not run between Circular Quay and Central Chalmers Street. L2 and L3 light rail services will continue running between Central and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford as per normal schedule.
  • On Tuesday 15 April, from 10.30pm until 1am, buses replace light rail from Central Chalmers Street to Moore Park. Light rail services will continue between Moore Park and Randwick and Kingsford.
  • Use alternative transport including trains, metro, regular bus services or walking if able to between Circular Quay and Central.
  • Train trackwork may also affect City Circle and T1 North Shore Line trains. Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information.
L1 replacement bus services:
 
Nightly from 8pm to 1am, replacement bus services will run between Central Grand Concourse and Dulwich Hill as follows:
  • From 8pm to 9pm: every 10 to 15 min
  • From 9pm to 1am: every 15 to 20 min.
    These times may vary depending on road traffic.
Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:
  • Capitol Square (towards Central and Dulwich Hill / The Star)
    - Please use the alternative stop at Central Grand Concourse or walk to Central Station (approx. 7 minute walk)
  • Exhibition Centre (towards Dulwich Hill / The Star)
    - Please use the alternative stop at Convention (approx. 7 minute walk)
  • Pyrmont Bay (towards Central and Dulwich Hill / The Star)
    - Please use the alternative stop at The Star (approx. 5 minute walk)
Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service.
See the news story for more detailed service information.
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner to see if your travel is affected.

urlText: Changes to school bus services and pass requirements in North Rothbury and Maitland area
content:
From Friday 31 January, a new morning and afternoon school bus service will run between North Rothbury and Rutherford Technology High School to meet student demand following community feedback. 
  • School route S526: A new service in the morning, operated by Grace Coaches will service North Rothbury, Branxton, Greta and Lochinvar before arriving at Rutherford Technology High School.
  • School route S526: A new afternoon service, operated by Grace Coaches will depart Rutherford Technology High School and service Greta, Branxton and North Rothbury.
Changes to other services:
  • Maitland Grossman High School and Maitland High School students who previously took the Grace Coaches S520 morning service should now take CDC school route 2571 and transfer to the regular route 180 service at Rutherford Shopping Centre (Hillview Street). In the afternoon, students can utilise the 2194 CDC school service.
  • Students from Maitland Public School, St John the Baptist Primary School and All Saints College who took the Grace Coaches S520 service to and from school will now catch the CDC school route 2712 morning service and the 2194 afternoon service.  
  • The S520 school route has been redesigned to service Rutherford and Aberglasslyn. 
Important:
  • Departure and arrival times and routes of some services have changed. Please check Trip Planner for details.
  • The school bus you travel on may be a CDC bus (operated by Hunter Valley Buses) or a Grace Coaches bus. If it is a CDC bus, you will need an Opal card. If it is a Grace Coaches bus, you will need a school travel pass. If your service has changed, find out more about how to apply for a pass. 
To view the adjusted routes and plan your trip, visit Trip Planner.
